label: A warning that goes to everybody's phones, like Hawaii
description: A message going out to everybody's phones telling people to go to a certain place, which the Lord compares to Hawaii, where he says it happened once before and where America has been protected and shielded so that nothing has ever happened on its soil like this. The 2018 Hawaii false missile alert is the obvious referent, so what would count as a match is a real alert of that kind on the mainland.

description: With enemies on every side, a people who have never seen God defend them will see it as the children of Israel did coming out of Egypt, with them rejoicing in the streets because the Lord became real to them in this generation, and he says twice that a major sign is about to be seen.
